decided_by: PI, 2026-10-02: naming locked before further Stage-4 results seal; 'Teachers' names a Stage-4 job, not the contribution; Separated is the same system as Ours and is not shown as a second row.
why_an_amendment_not_an_edit: The parent is a frozen framing record cited by specs, drivers and the school handoff. It stays byte-identical; this record governs naming from now on.
timing_note: Recorded while 2v2 Stage-4 diagnostics on the historical top-50 already existed (Share-Encoder sealed). The change is naming and table layout only: no system, checkpoint, seed, metric, or research question changes, and no result is relabeled to a different system.

Ours.definition: the main proposed method: symmetric dual-branch role-organized strategies, for each p in {A,B}: Pi_p = (pi_p,ATTACK, pi_p,DEFEND, H_k), H_k = CLOSEST_DEFENDS(k = ceil(N/3)), roles fixed per episode (DUAL_BRANCH_ROLE_COMPOSITE_V1)
Ours.note: 'teacher' may describe its job during Stage-4 distillation in prose, never its name

Fully Shared+z+r.definition: pi(a | o, z, r) distilled from Ours: one fully shared network conditioned on strategic mode z and role r
Fully Shared+z+r.role: shared latent-strategy realization of Ours; part of the proposed method, NOT a neutral baseline
Fully Shared+z+r.naming_rule: always written with '+r'; never shortened to 'Shared+z+r' (Share-Encoder is also shared) or to 'Fully Shared+z' (that is the historical asymmetric-teacher system, provenance only)

Share-Encoder.role: comparison architecture: partial sharing (shared encoder, private per-z branches)

Role-only (r).role: ablation: removes z while keeping r; tests whether z is necessary

No-Role Specialists.role: baseline: tests whether explicit ATTACK/DEFEND roles are necessary

TABLE_LAYOUT_locked.rule: Fully Shared+z+r appears in the Proposed group, with its role stated in the table, so it is not read as a baseline
TABLE_LAYOUT_locked.separated_row: removed: it is Ours deployed unchanged; one system, one row

SEED_RULE_locked.rule: In any Stage-4 table, the Ours row is scored on exactly the same seed list as the distilled systems in that table. Numbers from a different seed set (e.g. the Stage-3 matched-128 or historical top-50) are never placed in a Stage-4 table.
valid_sources: a fresh evaluation of Ours on the Stage-4 seed list

Ours rows already sealed on a superset of seeds, restricted to exactly the Stage-4 seed IDs (allowed because evaluation is deterministic per seed: same checkpoints, same seed -> same episode). Example: the dual-branch own top-50 rows taken from POSTHOC_MATCHED128_<N>V<N>_DUAL_BRANCH.
SEED_RULE_locked.must_record: the seed-list file + sha256 and the source rows file + sha256 for the Ours row of every Stage-4 table

UNCHANGED: every system, checkpoint, seed list, metric and evaluation
RESEARCH_QUESTIONS_locked RQ1-RQ4 and their evidence map (read Ours-Teachers as Ours, Ours-Shared as Fully Shared+z+r)
ALLOWED_OUTCOMES (Fully Shared+z+r may collapse; it stays part of the method if it does)
HISTORICAL_TABLES: old asymmetric Share-Encoder / Fully Shared+z / Generalist rows remain provenance and are never relabeled
